tob-0038-d6: FBI File 100-HQ-440423 is the Bureau’s investigative dossier on Dick Gregory — the comedian and civil rights activist. The released file documents years of surveillance of a prominent dissenter. It is a primary source on the COINTELPRO era. Researchers prize such files for the history of dissent.
tob-0039-d6: This roll of the Doctors’ Trial record keeps the official account of the 1946-47 Nuremberg case against Nazi doctors. Long testimony on cruel medical tests fills its pages. The trial gave the world the base rules of the Nuremberg Code.
